svg.title: Kernel thinning builds candidate halves, chooses the best, then swaps
svg.desc: Sixteen rows split into two groups of eight and then four candidate groups of four. The four structured candidates and a random group of four are compared with all rows. A swap pass replaces a selected row when an outside row lowers mismatch, producing four selected rows.
